verdict.rationale: Brave's docs explicitly market an LLM Context endpoint 'built for machine consumption, and benchmarked as the most powerful Search API for AI', pre-extracted content optimized for RAG, extra snippets for more context, Goggles-based re-ranking, and an official MCP server delivering 'LLM context' and summarization to agents. However, community evidence shows the free tier's ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate paid AI Inference plan to legally use this for RAG — a real caveat on out-of-the-box usability for developers testing at no cost. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks validating result sizing/chunking quality for RAG, and clarity/consistency between marketing (built for RAG) and ToS restrictions on the free tier.
